column1: # Arena candidates for the scout (RLArenaScout, dev tools). From the game's
# own map pins (ep1 03_night_city.mappins x cooked_journal.journal, joined by
# Murmur3 of the journal path): gang outposts and cyberpsycho spots (minor
# activities), and the first pin of every gig (street stories), Dogtown's
# included. Pins within 120 m of an existing arena or 80 m of another
# candidate were dropped, and a few that aren't fights (rewards, couriers,
# rooftops). Columns: kind, id, district, x, y, z.
